sourceReasoning.wash: Per linear-light texture RGB channel f(s)=0.651+0.3*s. 0.93 is a chosen anchor, not measured texture mean. Residual pairwise texture contrast is 30%; overall mean/base appearance can shift.
sourceReasoning.lighting: Vertex/material base colors and paint remain; AO/shadow/light code and mesh flags unchanged. Changes diffuse albedo used by lighting, so absolute rendered shadow/AO appearance can change; no claim of unchanged pixels.
sourceReasoning.ownership: wallWash is a city-owned clone, map/gradient borrowed from station. Explicit city dispose releases wall once and observed borrowed textures never dispose.
